race.comment: GINGER AND TONIC (10) looks the one to beat dropping out of Saturday company after finishing ninth behind Streak Of God at Belmont. That run was not a winning threat, but it was stronger grade than this and her broader profile reads well for the race, including repeated placings around 1500m and a proven partnership with Lisa Staples. CHEROKEE MISS (7) has recent figures that look plain, yet this is a more suitable assignment than the NMW1Y she tackled last time and she has three wins around this distance. KELORA (1) can rebound from a wide-run failure at Kalgoorlie, especially on the strength of his narrow fourth in NMW1Y grade two back. SAUCISSON (2) has to prove the last-start Belmont win at long odds was no one-off, but beating King Of The Town after missing the start gives him a genuine place in the winning mix. GONDRINKIN (8) is next best.
